name: World Paint Save Load Integration Contract

integrationPoints.behavior: load world source, then replay all paint deltas before first frame
load saved world, restore layout, replay all paint deltas, then refresh inspector
load generated pack, then replay all paint deltas against matching scene ids
replay all paint deltas before save so current world snapshot contains reconstructed paint edits
restore next paint sequence from max persisted delta sequence

multiplayerPolicy.authoritativeState: host/server stores compact paint delta operations and/or equivalent scene tile/material state
multiplayerPolicy.clientVisualState: clients derive shoreline, foam, variation, debris, and overlays deterministically
multiplayerPolicy.replaySafety: replay is idempotent at current resolved-tile level and should remain deterministic as subcell masks become persistent
